pages.title: Crops
pages.text: Hexalia introduces unique crops found across the world, each tied to specific environments and uses. They are essential for crafting foods, supporting rituals, and unlocking specialized effects.

pages.title: Types of Crops
pages.text: Crops fall into two broad groups.$(br2)$(li)Wild Crops are discovered in nature and cultivated from seeds.$(li)Specialized Crops require unique methods such as infusion or ritual transformation.

pages.title: Mandrake
pages.text: A volatile root found in forest regions. Its cry can be dangerous without protection, but it is valued for hearty meals such as Mandrake Stew.

pages.title: Sunfire Tomato
pages.text: A warm-climate crop discovered in savannas. Often used in spiced meals that grant bursts of speed and vitality.

pages.title: Chillberries
pages.text: Cold-grown berries found in taigas. They can be harvested and replanted, and are commonly used in meals that protect against heat.

pages.title: Saltsprout
pages.text: A desert plant that can be processed into Salt, a key material for rituals and magical workings.

pages.title: Galeberries
pages.text: Not found naturally, Galeberries are created through $(l:hexalia:core_mechanics/celestial_infusion)Celestial Infusion$(/l). They are used in crafted foods tied to enhanced perception.

pages.title: Rabbage
pages.text: Formed through $(l:hexalia:core_mechanics/natures_ritual)Nature's Ritual$(/l), Rabbage is both a resource and a tool, capable of being used in unconventional ways beyond simple nourishment.

pages.title: On Cultivation
pages.text: Many crops begin in the wild, but their true value comes from cultivation. With the right knowledge, they can be grown, processed, and integrated into more advanced Hexalia systems.
